releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.15.0 — everything from the gap report, actually working.

• Lyrics search: hum a line you remember and the song comes up.
• Real voice search — tap the mic and speak; your words land in the search box.
• Equalizer, Bass Boost and Loudness now change the sound on the actual player (7 presets, or tune each band yourself).
• Download quality, Wi-Fi-only downloads (they wait, then start by themselves) and a real storage limit.
• Offline mixtape: the app keeps a ready-to-play mix of your music on the phone.
• Playlists: pick a cover from the songs inside, search inside a playlist, and select several songs to download, queue or remove at once.
• Share a song from the exact second you are listening at, or share a designed image card.
• New today: Daylist (what you play at this time of day), Release Radar (new songs from artists you follow), Moments (saved seconds that jump straight back), and a Station builder — pick artists, set the variety.
• A real notification centre behind the Home bell: new releases, finished downloads, mixtape refreshes and waiting updates.
• Lyrics can show a translation or Latin-script reading when the lyrics catalogue provides one.
• A–B repeat, pinned playlists and playlist folders, and a shareable listening recap.
